mapper.select: SELECT id, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json FROM command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO command_idempotency(id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{canonicalVersion}, #{paramsSha256}, #{paramsCanonical}, 'RESERVED', NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, sign_in_daily_points, sign_in_streak_bonus_points, invite_per_invitee_points, invite_monthly_reward_cap, invite_milestone_bonus_points, first_order_points, profile_complete_points, version, created_at, updated_at FROM points_task_config WHERE scope = #{scope}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_task_config (id, scope, sign_in_daily_points, sign_in_streak_bonus_points, invite_per_invitee_points, invite_monthly_reward_cap, invite_milestone_bonus_points, first_order_points, profile_complete_points, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{scope}, #{signInDailyPoints}, #{signInStreakBonusPoints}, #{invitePerInviteePoints}, #{inviteMonthlyRewardCap}, #{inviteMilestoneBonusPoints}, #{firstOrderPoints}, #{profileCompletePoints}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sign_in_daily_points = #{signInDailyPoints}, sign_in_streak_bonus_points = #{signInStreakBonusPoints}, invite_per_invitee_points = #{invitePerInviteePoints}, invite_monthly_reward_cap = #{inviteMonthlyRewardCap}, invite_milestone_bonus_points = #{inviteMilestoneBonusPoints}, first_order_points = #{firstOrderPoints}, profile_complete_points = #{profileCompletePoints}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now}
INSERT INTO points_sign_in(id, user_id, sign_date, points, streak_after, ledger_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{signDate}, #{points}, #{streakAfter}, #{ledgerId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, inviter_id, invitee_id, invite_code, state, reward_period, rewarded_at, reward_ledger_id, created_at FROM points_referral_binding WHERE invitee_id = #{inviteeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_referral_binding (id, inviter_id, invitee_id, invite_code, state, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{inviteCode}, 'BOUND', #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, inviter_id, invitee_id, invite_code, state, reward_period, rewarded_at, reward_ledger_id, created_at FROM points_referral_binding WHERE inviter_id = #{inviterId} AND state = 'BOUND' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limitRows}
SELECT id, inviter_id, invitee_id, invite_code, state, reward_period, rewarded_at, reward_ledger_id, created_at FROM points_referral_binding WHERE inviter_id = #{inviterId} AND state = 'REWARDED'
mapper.update: UPDATE points_referral_binding SET state = 'REWARDED', reward_period = #{rewardPeriod}, reward_ledger_id = #{rewardLedgerId}, rewarded_at = #{rewardedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'BOUND'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_task_award(id, user_id, task_code, points, ledger_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{taskCode}, #{points}, #{ledgerId}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO points_ledger(id, user_id, biz_type, biz_id, order_id, delta, balance_after, request_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, NULL, #{delta}, #{balanceAfter}, #{requestId}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO points_ledger(id, user_id, biz_type, biz_id, order_id, delta, balance_after, request_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{orderId}, #{delta}, #{balanceAfter}, #{requestId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, biz_id, delta, created_at FROM points_ledger WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND biz_type = 'ORDER_REWARD' AND delta > 0 ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-delta), 0) FROM points_ledger WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND biz_type = 'REFUND_CLAWBACK' AND delta < 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_account(id, user_id, balance, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{delta}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE balance = balance + #{delta}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now}
